questions.text: An embedded system is best described as:
choices: A computer system designed to perform a dedicated function within a larger system

questions.text: Compared to a microprocessor, a microcontroller typically includes:
choices: CPU, memory and peripherals on a single chip

questions.text: Which memory keeps its contents when power is removed?

choices: One shared bus for instructions and data
Separate memories/buses for instructions and data

choices: Reads LOW when nothing is connected
Reads HIGH when nothing is connected

choices: Control the average power to a load such as LED brightness or motor speed
